highlightAliases.old: Sildenafil/vardenafil: take on an empty stomach; food does not significantly impair tadalafil/avanafil absorption. Tadalafil lasts longer (p552).
highlightAliases.new: High-fat meals can delay the effect of sildenafil or vardenafil. Tadalafil and avanafil may be taken with or without food, although a high-fat meal can also delay peak avanafil concentration. Tadalafil has a longer window of action (p552). FDA avanafil prescribing information, §§2.1 and 12.3.
